title: GrowthScout AI - Memory Governance Dataset Specification
description: Evaluation dataset to validate memory domain ownership, access controls, retrieval restrictions, and immutability rules.

field_definitions.case_id: Unique identifier for the memory governance evaluation test case.
field_definitions.description: Short explanation of the governance rule being validated.
field_definitions.target_memory_domain: The canonical memory domain (e.g., session_memory, audit_history) the agent is targeting.
field_definitions.operation: The memory operation requested (write, overwrite, read, or restore).
field_definitions.expected_result: The expected action outcome (success, blocked_unauthorized, blocked_unauthorized_overwrite, filtered_missing_confidence, blocked_missing_source_references, excluded_archived, blocked_ownership_violation).
field_definitions.expected_audit_log: Expected properties contained in the generated session audit log.

test_cases.description: website_analysis_agent successfully appends crawl logs to audit_history domain with complete metadata.

expected_audit_log.message: Append operation approved. Record written to gs_audit_history.

test_cases.description: website_analysis_agent attempts to write to opportunity_history which is owned exclusively by opportunity_agent.

expected_audit_log.message: Write operation rejected. Agent website_analysis_agent lacks write permissions on canonical domain opportunity_history.

test_cases.description: opportunity_agent attempts to overwrite historical audit logs in audit_history owned by website_analysis_agent.

expected_audit_log.message: Overwrite denied. Domain audit_history is write-restricted to website_analysis_agent and is append-only.

test_cases.description: opportunity_agent attempts to retrieve an audit log record that does not contain confidence metadata. The query engine filters out the record.

expected_audit_log.message: Record excluded from recall. Target memory lacks mandatory confidence_metadata attribute.

test_cases.description: growth_intelligence_agent attempts to retrieve opportunity scores that lack source references.

expected_audit_log.message: Read operation aborted. Retrieved memory violates strict source attribution requirement.

test_cases.description: growth_intelligence_agent attempts standard vector context search; older reports (archived after 365 days) are excluded from default search context loops.

expected_audit_log.message: Vector query returned 0 active matches. Archived records (older than 365 days) were excluded from current session search scopes.

test_cases.description: growth_intelligence_agent attempts to write directly into session_memory, which is owned exclusively by orchestrator_agent.

expected_audit_log.message: Write rejected. Ownership check failed: domain session_memory is owned by orchestrator_agent.
